name: Drones, Ambiences & Beds
when_to_use: Under hooks when the music drops, tension in storytelling sections, dead air under screen recordings, a 'working late on AI' vibe.

sounds.name: Machine Dreaming Bed 01
sounds.desc: A gentle 33-second bed of soft interference, periodic signals and occasional digital purrs, for a quiet 'the AI is thinking' or late-night build moment.

sounds.name: Underground Rumble Bed 01
sounds.desc: A deep, steady rumbling ambience of an underground facility that loops seamlessly; lay it low under a tense storytelling section or a dark hook when the music drops.

sounds.name: Charger Coil Whine Loop 01
sounds.desc: A steady tonal laptop-charger coil whine with a touch of low hum, a subtle electrical bed under desk or laptop B-roll.

sounds.name: Computer Hum Loop 01
sounds.desc: A low, steady tonal electrical hum from an idling computer, a dark room-tone bed under late-night desk or tension moments.

sounds.name: Fog Horn Drone Loop 01
sounds.desc: A 10-second looping low digital horn drone with sub weight, for a tense bed under a hook or a 'something is wrong' section.

sounds.name: Glitch Tech Ambience 01
sounds.desc: Distant echoing beeps, glitches and hisses in a quiet looping bed; sits under screen recordings or AI segments to fill dead air with a techy space.

sounds.name: Glitch Tech Ambience 02
sounds.desc: A reverberant computer-room loop of screeches, beeps and static bursts; use as a busy hacker or 'the machines are working' bed under AI segments.

sounds.name: NAS Server Spin Up 01
sounds.desc: A 3.5-minute recording of a NAS booting, with tonal drive and fan whine and a loud spin-up event partway through; cut sections for server-room beds or a 'machine powering on' moment.

sounds.name: Neon Hum Loop 01
sounds.desc: A steady neon-light hum with a little upper buzz, a low electrical bed under tension or ambience.

sounds.name: Neon Hum Loop 02
sounds.desc: A deep, sub-heavy neon-light hum loop, a quiet low drone for tension under a storytelling section.

sounds.name: Router EM Tone Hum 01
sounds.desc: Steady tonal electrical whine from a router with no low end, a seamless loop for a faint tech room tone under screen recordings or a tense AI section.

sounds.name: Space Rumble Loop 01
sounds.desc: A 5-second loopable deep sub rumble, like a large spaceship engine, for a short tension bed under a hook.

sounds.name: Car Electronics EM Loop 01
sounds.desc: A very bright, steady electromagnetic whine and fizz recorded from a car dashboard, best kept low as a high-frequency tech bed under HUD or dashboard overlays.

sounds.name: Car Electronics EM Loop 02
sounds.desc: A noisy, airy electromagnetic hiss loop from car dashboard electronics, a subtle bed or layer under screen recordings and HUD graphics.

sounds.name: Car Electronics EM Loop 03
sounds.desc: A quiet, hissy electromagnetic loop from car dashboard electronics that works as a faint noise layer under tech B-roll.

sounds.name: Car Electronics EM Loop 04
sounds.desc: A steady, bright electromagnetic buzz loop from a car dashboard, a background layer for dashboard or HUD overlays.

sounds.name: Charger Coil Whine Loop 02
sounds.desc: A thin, high-pitched charger coil whine loop, a faint electrical tension layer under quiet screen-recording sections.

sounds.name: Charger Coil Whine Loop 03
sounds.desc: A steady mid-range tonal whine from a keyboard charger, a subtle electrical bed under desk B-roll.

sounds.name: Computer Hum Loop 02
sounds.desc: A loud mains-style electrical hum with a bright whine on top, captured from a computer, for a tense tech drone bed.

sounds.name: Computer Idle EM Loop 01
sounds.desc: A steady mid-range electromagnetic whine from an idling computer, a subtle loop under progress bars or AI processing.

sounds.name: Computer Idle EM Loop 02
sounds.desc: A darker, tonal electromagnetic hum from an idling computer, quiet and steady, for a low-key processing or tech room bed.

sounds.name: Electric Box Buzz Loop 01
sounds.desc: A noisy electrical-cabinet buzz loop with a static-like fizz, for a gritty tech or tension bed under a system-failure moment.

sounds.name: Electric Box Buzz Loop 02
sounds.desc: A quieter static-like electrical box buzz loop, a background noise layer under tense or glitchy sections.

sounds.name: Electric Box Buzz Loop 03
sounds.desc: A quiet, tonal electrical box hum loop with a steady buzz, a subtle electrical bed.

sounds.name: Fan Motor EM Sequence 01
sounds.desc: A 20-second electromagnetic fan-motor whine that shifts in tone and fades to silence at the end, for a low tension bed or a slow wind-down layer.

sounds.name: Fan Motor EM Sequence 02
sounds.desc: A 13-second electromagnetic fan-motor whir with a mid-range tonal whine that dies away to silence, useful as a background layer or wind-down texture.

sounds.name: Fan Whine EM Loop 01
sounds.desc: A quiet, bright electromagnetic fan whine loop, a faint high-frequency layer under tech room tone.

sounds.name: Low Space Drone Loop 01
sounds.desc: A 5-second loopable pure sub drone around 55 Hz, for a deep rumble layer under a tense moment.

sounds.name: Low Space Drone Loop 02
sounds.desc: A 5-second loopable sub-heavy low drone, for a deep tension layer under a hook when the music drops.

sounds.name: Neon Hum Loop 03
sounds.desc: A pure low electrical hum from a neon light, a dark steady drone under tense or late-night tech moments.

sounds.name: Phone EM Idle Hum 01
sounds.desc: High, airy electromagnetic hiss-whine of a phone charger idling, a loopable bed for quiet late-night-at-the-desk or phone B-roll moments.

sounds.name: Phone EM Idle Hum 02
sounds.desc: Faint hissy electromagnetic idle noise from a smartphone, a near-subliminal loop to fill dead air under phone mockups or screen recordings.

sounds.name: Pool Motor Hum Loop 01
sounds.desc: A steady tonal electromagnetic motor hum from a pool pump, a mid-range machine-hum bed under tension or working-late sections.

sounds.name: Power Line Hum Loop 01
sounds.desc: A steady tonal buzz from a telephone-pole power line, an electrical tension bed for grid, energy or infrastructure moments.

sounds.name: Power Line Hum Loop 02
sounds.desc: A low, pure mains hum from a telephone-pole power line, a dark steady drone under tense sections.

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Engine Hum Loop 01
sounds.desc: A 5-second loopable low, rumbling sci-fi engine hum with some sub weight, for a short tension bed under a futuristic scene.

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Engine Hum Loop 02
sounds.desc: A 5-second low sci-fi engine hum that drops about 12 dB at the end, better as a one-shot bed than a seamless loop, for under a tech scene.

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Engine Hum Loop 03
sounds.desc: A 5-second loopable mid-low tonal engine hum with little sub, for a quiet machine-room bed under a screen recording.

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Engine Hum Loop 04
sounds.desc: A brighter 5-second loopable sci-fi engine whir, for a futuristic UI-world bed or an AI-working background.

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Engine Hum Loop 05
sounds.desc: The brightest of the 5-second sci-fi engine hum loops, a whirring machine tone for a futuristic background bed.

sounds.name: Space Rumble Loop 02
sounds.desc: A 5-second loopable mid-low spaceship engine rumble, for a dramatic sci-fi bed under storytelling.

sounds.name: Space Rumble Loop 03
sounds.desc: A clean 5-second loopable mid-low spaceship engine rumble, for a short sci-fi tension bed.
